ai_summary: The funding supports federally-recognized Tribes or Tribal Entities in establishing or enhancing Institutional Review Boards for biomedical research. Eligible applicants include federally-recognized AI/AN Tribes, Tribal colleges, health programs, or organizations, with a focus on those involved in human research oversight.
ai_quote: "enable federally-recognized Tribes or Tribal Entities to establish or enhance Institutional Review Boards."
